pr_title: Add 2FA verification screen to registration flow

issue_context.title: In-game account registration doesn't work
issue_context.body: It's likely stuck on 2FA, not sure if it requires just a UI change in the client or if the web flow is not working as expected.

review_comments: This is kind of sketchy (bound and never unbound), but maybe it's fine.
It's a local bindable though? Would like to think the auto-unbind flow would take care of it.
Yeah, it's fine as long as the screen is never reused, which I think is fine.
